text:
alex.k: Quick sync from the postmortem 
We need a clear external comms path: statuspage blurb, a near-term customer summary, and policy for sharing the full RCA. Who will own copy + distribution?

priya: I can do the public blurb and post it to the draft queue. Prefer one-sentence + next-steps promise.

sam: I'll prepare the 48-72h customer summary skeleton and call out recurrence patterns we saw.

maria: I'll own the redaction policy & approvals with Legal. We should list what technical items stay internal vs what we can publish externally.

alex.k: Good. Let's set concrete AIs with owners and deadlines so nothing slips.

priya: Drafting AIs here  react with :thumbsup: to accept or comment: 

```
AI-101: Priya 	 Draft public statuspage blurb by Thu 14:00 UTC and post to Statuspage draft for review.
AI-102: Sam 	 Create 72h customer summary skeleton (timeline, impact metrics, recurrence analysis, next steps) by Fri 12:00 UTC.
AI-103: Maria 	 Deliver redaction checklist + approval flow with Legal by Fri 17:00 UTC.
AI-104: Support Lead 	 Produce impacted-customer list + outreach owners by Thu 18:00 UTC.
AI-105: Alex.k 	 Add above AIs to ticket PM-462, assign due dates, and confirm final approver for public copy.
```

support-lead: Accept AI-104. I'll export the incident list and tag outreach owners by end of day.

sam: Accept AI-102. I'll include the recurring-patterns note: we observed a DB failover spike roughly every 36-48 hours under circuit-breaker congestion. Will recommend a runbook tweak.

maria: Accept AI-103 conditional on Legal review. I'll schedule a 20-min slot with Legal for Fri morning to go through the checklist.

legal-bot: Reminder: any external RCA with customer-identifiable data requires Legal sign-off and potentially NDA.

alex.k: Priya, can you paste a first-draft blurb so we can iterate here? Keep it consumer-friendly.

priya: Draft: 

"We experienced elevated API error rates between 03:12 and 04:05 UTC due to an internal database failover. Some requests returned 5xx errors. Normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after traffic rerouting and failover completion. We apologize for the disruption and will publish a follow-up summary within 72 hours describing impact and next steps."

sam: Nice. Suggest adding a short apology and link to the status updates page.

priya: Update: 

"We experienced intermittent API errors between 03:12and 04:05 UTC caused by a database failover. Affected requests may have returned 5xx errors; normal service resumed at 04:05 UTC after rerouting traffic. We sincerely apologize for the disruption. A follow-up summary with impact metrics and next steps will be published within 72 hours: <link-to-status-updates>."

maria: That works for public blurb. For the 72h summary, we should keep detailed runbook commands and any internal hostnames out; provide timeline, measured impact (requests affected, error rates), and broad mitigation steps. Full RCA to be available on request with redactions applied.

priya: Noted. Support Lead: do you want the 72h summary proactively sent to Dedicated customers or only to those flagged as impacted?

support-lead: Proactively send to Dedicated and to customers in the impacted list. I'll coordinate owners for follow-up calls.

alex.k: Sam, include a short section in the 72h doc proposing one or two specific runbook changes to prevent recurrence. We'll triage those into the next operations sprint.

sam: Will do I'll propose an automated circuit-breaker backoff and a short maintenance window for DB failover testing.

maria: After Legal signs off on the redaction checklist, I'll attach the checklist to the public summary ticket and mark which fields are always redacted.

incident-bot: Action items AI-101..AI-105 added to PM-462 with due dates.

alex.k: Perfect. Timeline recap: Priya posts status blurb to draft by Thu 14:00; Support Lead shares impacted customer owners by Thu 18:00; Sam drops 72h draft by Fri 12:00; Maria completes redaction template and Legal review by Fri 17:00. If anyone needs to change an ETA, update here.

priya: I'll post the draft in ~40 minutes. :thumbsup: 

support-lead: Exporting customer list now.

sam: Starting the 72h skeleton. Will ping when in PM-462.

maria: Scheduling Legal review for Fri 09:30.

alex.k: Thanks everyone. Closing loop: I'll check PM-462 tomorrow morning and confirm approvals. If we see new recurrence signals, call it out ASAP in this thread.

priya: :raised_hands:
